# cpanel_ssl_csr (Data Source)

Looks up one public certificate signing request stored by cPanel. The data source reads only signed public PKCS#10 material and metadata; it never reads private keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_csr" "example" {
  id = "csr-id-from-cpanel"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The CSR identifier assigned by cPanel.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The CSR common name.
- `country_name` (String) The two-letter country code.
- `created` (Number) The CSR creation time reported by cPanel as a Unix timestamp.
- `csr` (String) The canonical PEM-encoded public PKCS#10 certificate signing request.
- `domains` (List of String) The CSR domains with the common name first.
- `ecdsa_curve_name` (String) The ECDSA curve name reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `ecdsa_public` (String) The ECDSA public point reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `email_address` (String) The optional certificate subject email address.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) The lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the PKCS#10 DER bytes.
- `friendly_name` (String) The display name stored by cPanel for the CSR.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The CSR public-key algorithm reported by cPanel.
- `locality_name` (String) The certificate subject city or locality.
- `modulus` (String) The RSA public modulus reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `organization_name` (String) The certificate subject organization.
- `organizational_unit_name` (String) The optional certificate subject organizational unit.
- `state_or_province_name` (String) The certificate subject state or province.
